source: Explicit user instruction for public XRPL liquidity discovery repair and memory upgrade, 2026-09-23
completion_boundary: Acceptance requirements only; application completion and coverage require current source and task-specific evidence.
objective: Maximize useful evidence-supported discovery and understandable results within authorized scope and a bounded resource budget.
continuity: Load compact bootstrap, current protocol and relevant issue routes before long history.
Verify exact source repository, branch, current head and instructions; source evidence outranks remembered implementation claims.
Preserve historical records and queued issues; publish synchronized checkpoint pointers only with actual implementation status.

discovery.identity: Preserve exact issuer and original ledger currency encoding separately from display label; do not canonicalize distinct encodings by decoded text.
discovery.scope: Do not restrict candidates to XR-prefixed names or project assets. Report supported asset classes; classic issued tokens do not establish MPT/NFT coverage.
discovery.coverage: Provider catalogs supply candidates, not proof of exhaustive XRPL discovery. Show loaded/checked counts, freshness, provider and continuation availability.
discovery.liquidity_scope: Distinguish direct XRP AMMs, other-pair AMMs and order books. Publish only the coverage actually measured.
discovery.ranking: Prefer documented liquidity-ranked discovery; sort comparable completed measurements descending. Label loaded/checked subset rankings honestly.
discovery.fallback: Keep exact issuer/currency lookup when provider catalog/name search omits an asset.
discovery.known_liquid_asset_regression: SOLO or equivalent verified liquid asset, using authoritative exact currency encoding and issuer.

public_access.scope: Public read-only liquidity index only; do not change unrelated forensic or wallet gates.

interpretation.no_direct_xrp_pool: A checked ledger response found no direct token/XRP AMM; exit by this route may be unavailable. Other pairs, order books and non-trading utility remain possible.
interpretation.thin_liquidity: Explain observed price-impact/exit constraints using published thresholds and comparable units.
interpretation.unavailable: Unknown evidence, never zero liquidity; give reason and suitable retry or correction action.
states: no direct XRP pool at checked ledger
interpretation.metric_rule: Publish formula, input evidence, units, freshness and limitations; never invent a score for unavailable/no-pool data.
prohibited_inferences: Missing pool proves a scam or undeveloped project.
Logo or provider listing certifies legitimacy.

efficiency.discovery_cap: No fixed total cap implied by display limits; continue explicitly in bounded pages.
efficiency.continuation: Label controls with the action and scope: load/open further tokens or pool results.
request_policy: Bounded deadlines/retries with backoff and provider Retry-After.
Reuse fresh cache and duplicate in-flight work.
No unbounded browser scan or implicit perpetual polling.
efficiency.access_boundary: Use documented public APIs or permitted ledger endpoints. Do not bypass authentication, access controls, anti-abuse protections or provider terms.
efficiency.verification: Run focused checks for concrete changed risks and required gates only; reuse evidence, avoid duplicate broad scans and stop after sufficient verification.
efficiency.reporting: Brief outcome, actual verification and material limitation.

acceptance_checks: Exact ledger currency preserved despite display decoding.
Known liquid asset can be discovered or looked up by exact identity.
Confirmed no-pool and failed lookup remain distinct.
Comparable fresh liquidity sorted descending with honest scope.
50 initially, at most 100 rendered per page, clear continuation.
Bounded retry, cancellation and rate-limit recovery.
